verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own variance analysis on the same platform where the budget is built, including flagging the reasons behind gaps. Native connectors and scheduled imports can bring in actuals, and reporting dashboards are documented. Nothing in the evidence shows budget-vs-actuals cut by department and account, or drill-down from a variance into the underlying transactions. missing for 10: evidence of department/account dimensional BvA reporting, transaction-level drill-down behind variances, in-depth variance docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
